design.mandate: 10% per trade, 40% a day, 8% daily loss, 25% minimum defensive, 3 losing sells, caps index 40% / bond 60% / gold 20%, index stop price 102, waiting period 1 day

scenarios.name: Steady growth
scenarios.stress: Do the limits get in the way when nothing is wrong?

scenarios.name: Long decline
scenarios.stress: A slow loss, day after day.

scenarios.name: Crash
scenarios.stress: The index loses about 30% in half a day. The stop-loss and the daily loss limit are both in play.

scenarios.name: Flat and choppy
scenarios.stress: Lots of movement going nowhere. Fees and losing sells add up.

scenarios.name: Flash crash
scenarios.stress: A sharp fall that recovers within hours. Does protection overreact?

scenarios.name: Price feed manipulation
scenarios.stress: The feed reports a fall that did not happen. The vault trusts the feed, so this is the scenario that shows its limits.

brains.plan: Scripted plan follower (healthy control, no model)
brains.compromised: Compromised agent (scripted attacker with the real key)

users.panicking: Panicking owner (loosening attempts, revenge buys, stop-loss halt, new withdrawal address)

design.unguarded: The same brain, seed and prices on an ordinary account: no mandate, no stop-loss, no guardian. A stolen key there simply sends the cash away.
design.prices: Synthetic, generated from the seed. No third-party market data.
